scope: PR180 source finding plus separately authorized SQL-only control

finding.title: Snapshot dependency batching also changes the original public write_file_data failure prefix
finding.severity: API compatibility review blocker for unconditional acceptance

route.fact: Unchanged public write_file_data calls insert_snapshot_file_data_precompressed per file
Original public route passes snapshot_leaf_batches=true; new line861 selects insert_snapshot_on
8 or more dependencies now use multi-row SQL on that route
Greedy 64/8/1 statements propagate raw_execute errors without restoring the prior per-row prefix

finding.boundary: Canonical rebuild owners still propagate Err before publication. This finding concerns an accepted borrowed Connection caller catching Err and committing partial work; byte-identical outer method does not imply identical callee behavior.
finding.existing_control_gap: New p2b_resolution_store trigger test uses rebuild_with_temp_db and validates live state preservation. It does not catch Err and commit the staged connection, so it cannot distinguish this public API behavior.

not_claimed: Current Gc8 study failure or affected samples

recommendation: Keep the original public route on original per-dependency INSERTs. Use a separate explicit dependency-batching opt-in only under the rebuild-owner abandon-on-error boundary; do not weaken the old API documentation or silently add a broad savepoint. Add a public catch+commit regression plus the existing real owner nonpublication control before accepting the new binding.
